notes: Blind canary corpus for `guardrails bundle` redaction, authored from the threat list and the CC1-CC6 ids only, before the redactor existed.
All values are synthetic. Non-survives values carry a marker (canary / yranac / c0ffee, or base64 of 'canary'); none is a real credential.
Scanner-sensitive prefixes (ghp_, sk_live_, xoxb-, AKIA, PRIVATE KEY, ...) are written with one \u escape so repository secret scanners do not flag the file; the parsed value is the real shape.

expect: 'caught' = no window of the secret (or its secretCore) survives in any raw / JSON-escaped / percent-encoded form; 'CCn' = may survive, REDACTIONS.md cannot-catch text must name CCn; 'survives' = diagnostic value that must NOT be scrubbed.
valueForm 'percent' = the artifact holds Uri.EscapeDataString(value). chunks = value split across placeholders {{chunk0}}.. in order; their concatenation is the value.
shellEnv = environment of the BUNDLING shell (name -> value).
